formattedAddress: No. 1-5, Lane 183, Section 2, Zhongshan N Rd, Heng'an Village, Zhongshan District, Taipei City, Taiwan 10491

text.text:
A fine dining restaurant that needs reservations in advance and deposits.

The food is Chinese Taiwanese with fusion feel. They don’t serve wine so you need to get your own and there will be a cleaning fee for each glass used or per bottle basis.

The deco is very interesting as it retains the old tradition Taiwanese houses and structures with modern settings.

The food was all fine and beautifully presented. Everything tasted good, especially the Chicken Soup, very satisfying. The fruits and vinegar drinks were more ordinary.

They were quite strict about the dining time limits of 2 hours, so you need to be prepared and be mindful about it.

You can bring your own wine and they will provide glasses but not serve you., which means you need to do it yourselves.

text.text: Enjoyed nice service and food.  Loved the hearty chicken soup and was impressed by the flaky garlic pork with porridge！ If the fried wagyu bread changed to plain one would be probably more appreciated！
